title: 1Kit Hunt
description:
17 Hidden 1Kits all over minecraft textures!

body: i am the 1 kit, a green goblin. I made a texture pack egg hunt of sorts, As in I've hid myself all over minecraft textures. So if your interested you can try to find all 17 Kits in minecraft. (NO CHEATING!) (you can do this in creative) In gallery Ive put related screenshots with a small clues or riddles BYE!!
